'''Athlone Town Association Football Club''' is an [[Republic of Ireland|Irish]] [[association football|football]] club from [[Athlone]] who are playing in the [[League of Ireland]]. The club is the oldest in the League as it was founded in 1887.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Lynch |first=Frank |title=A History of Athlone Town F.C. – the first 101 years |year=1991 |location=Athlone |page=1 |quote=The record books give 1892 as the year of our founding ... as it was in that year that the club became affiliated to the [[Leinster Football Association]], with the object of competing in the newly inaugurated [[Leinster Junior Cup (association football)|Leinster Junior Cup]]. However, for the real date of birth we must refer to our esteemed local paper the Westmeath Independent, which in its issue dated 8 January 1887 stated 'We are in a position to announce that O.R. Coote Esq., Larkfield is organising a club under Association rules and already a large number of young men of the town have become members...'|publisher=None}}</ref> First elected to the League of Ireland in 1922, they play their home matches in [[Athlone Town Stadium|Lissywollen]], their new stadium which opened in 2007. The Athlone Town AFC Women's team were established in 2020 and have been very successful in their few shorts years, winning multiple League and Cup titles."}}
